description: AFFECT FRAME + CODEBOOK (block 369000; design and predictions in docs/research/psychology_affect/AFFECT_FRAME_CODEBOOK_PREREG.md). Each fired emotion of core_emotions publishes one integer affect frame, an Observation of relations aff:<tag>:val_sign, aff:<tag>:val_level and aff:<tag>:ar_level, whose levels are LogQuantum base-2 log levels of the emotion's own magnitudes. The unchanged shape_decode_loop decodes each frame against twelve affect ShapeSignature parts (the codebook, copied from the canonical appraisals' frames). An intensity change arrives as a per-predicate quantum delta and is recognised as recognized_transformed with no growth. The af_direction rule compares the frames of two successive appraisals (follows edge) and writes val_direction and ar_direction. Opt-in and self_load_only: no existing seed is changed, and the old valence/arousal contract is untouched. No Rust, no Python decision.
